newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Skanska has no comment on chairman rumour.
newsitem.headline: Skanska has no comment on chairman rumour.

text.p: Swedish construction company Skanska said on Monday it would not comment on newspaper reports that chief executive Melker Schorling would become the new chairman.
"No, we don't have any comments," Skanska spokesman Lennart Hallberg said. "This is an ownership issue."
He added Skanska did not intend to release any information on the issue on Monday and could give no timing of any possible release.
Swedish daily Svenska Dagbladet said Schorling would replace Percy Barnevik who will step down to take the chair at Investor, the investment vehicle of Sweden's powerful Wallenberg family.
